title: Tool card
description: The front matter of catalog/tools/<id>.md. The id is the file name. A tool card is written for any project: one tied to a language describes the role (the project's test command), and names products only as examples from several stacks.

sensors.description: The sensors this tool builds. The sensor's card never lists its tools: that is computed from here.

layer.description: Where the tool is: project (run from the project's checkout: its commands and libraries, and the command-line tools beside them), system (outside it: a service, an environment or a store the project reaches), agent (part of the coding agent itself).
